description: N50 secondary permanent holdout, cycle 2026Q2. Per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-22-n50-secondary-holdout-design.md. Never-touch for weight tuning, routing, or meta-learner feedback. One-time measurement per release cycle, then retired. Seed batch only — curation continues in subsequent sessions toward n_target=50.
bsa_rationale: ICRP Reference Man (70 kg × 1.74 m) BSA. Spec §9 Open Questions #1 resolved to 1.85. Used for all mg/m² → mg conversions in this file.
methodology_notes: Observed Cmax reported as mean ± SD when primary source uses arithmetic statistics; as geometric mean with 90% CI in notes when that is the primary-source convention. SD field is null for geometric-mean-only sources. 2026-04-22 seed expansion (commit pending): added paclitaxel, docetaxel, micafungin, benzylpenicillin, torsemide (5 OATP1B1 substrates). benzylpenicillin classified as iv_infusion duration 4 min (rather than iv_bolus) because the FDA label's 3-5 min push is physically a short zero-order input; V3.1 infusion path handles it correctly and matches the Cmax timing (400 mg/L at 5-6 min post-start). 2026-04-22 second expansion (this session): added vimseltinib, nerandomilast, balcinrenone, tolebrutinib, zibotentan (5 non-OATP1B1 oral drugs). Cmax in nmol/L converted to mg/L using MW from PubChem: nerandomilast MW=449.0 g/mol (710 nmol/L x 449.0/1000 = 0.3188 mg/L); balcinrenone MW=399.4 g/mol (4602 nmol/L x 399.4/1000 = 1.838 mg/L).

rifampin.notes: Dual OATP1B1 substrate + inhibitor; the single-dose IV 600 mg measurement avoids chronic-induction confounds of repeat dosing. Tirona et al 2003 JPET 305:1028 establishes OATP1B1 substrate role at plasma concentrations in this range. MW 822 is above the 800 Da threshold commonly used for AD flagging — engine may flag in_domain=False. This is fine; the N50 is for generalization measurement, not domain restriction.

irinotecan.notes: Nozawa et al 2005 DMD 33:434 established OATP1B1 substrate role. Cmax reported here is for parent irinotecan only (not SN-38 active metabolite). SN-38 is formed by intracellular CES1/2 hydrolysis and is the pharmacologically active species, but clinical Cmax of SN-38 is 0.0263 mg/L — not what our engine would try to predict from a dose of irinotecan. Per spec §A1, we evaluate parent Cmax only. Prodrug-to-metabolite dynamics are a DDI/metabolism question explicitly out of scope.

paclitaxel.notes: OATP1B3 (primary) + OATP1B1 (secondary) substrate per Smith NF et al 2005 Chem Biol Interact 152:287–298; established in Leblanc et al 2018 DMD review as well. Paclitaxel is solubilized in Cremophor EL, which itself perturbs PK nonlinearly; the FDA label Cmax reflects the clinically administered Cremophor-containing product (i.e., Taxol, not nab-paclitaxel Abraxane). Mean Cmax 3650 ng/mL = 3.65 mg/L. SD not provided by the label — arithmetic mean only, consistent with rifampin entry precedent. Cross-study interstudy median from Vion 2023 systematic review (PMC8572663) Table 1 is 5.1 μM (= 4.35 mg/L at MW 853.9) [IQR 4.5–5.7 μM = 3.84–4.87 mg/L] across n=18 studies, reassuringly close to label value. Nonlinear PK: Cmax increases supra-proportionally with dose (Gianni 1995 JCO 13:180–190). AAFE-interpretation caveat: engine Cmax prediction may over/under estimate depending on whether nonlinear saturation is modeled.

docetaxel.dose_conversion_note: 100 mg/m² × BSA 1.85 m² = 185 mg. Used 100 mg/m² (not 75 mg/m²) because Baker 2004 reports Cmax mean ± SD at this dose; 75 mg/m² is reported in the same paper only as later-timepoint concentrations. 100 mg/m² is an FDA-approved dose for breast and NSCLC indications.

docetaxel.notes: OATP1B3 (primary) + OATP1B1 (secondary) substrate per Smith NF et al 2005 Chem Biol Interact 152:287–298 and de Graan et al 2012 Clin Cancer Res 18:4433–4440. Cmax is arithmetic mean ± SD in Baker 2004. Solubilized in Polysorbate 80 (Taxotere formulation), analogous to Cremophor EL issue for paclitaxel but with less PK nonlinearity. 100 mg/m² over 1-hour infusion was the original FDA-approved dose; 75 mg/m² is used in many combinations and is also FDA-approved.

micafungin.notes: OATP1B1 substrate role established by Sandhu et al 2005 Antimicrob Agents Chemother 49:2602–2609 (alongside caspofungin, already admitted to N50). Large cyclic lipopeptide MW 1270 — will trigger AD flag for molecular weight, analogous to caspofungin. Cmax reported as geometric mean (SD in parentheses per the paper's Table 2 legend). Cross-check: Hebert 2005 J Clin Pharmacol 45:1145–1152 (in the same weighted-average pool) gave Cmax 8.8 mg/L with CV 20% at n=26 healthy volunteers; Chandrasekar & Sobel 2006 CID Table 1 aggregates to 9.1 mg/L weighted across Hebert and other registered healthy-volunteer studies. Value used here (10.3) is the Undre 2014 primary paper's directly tabulated 100 mg Cmax in matched healthy controls.

benzylpenicillin.dose_original: 5 million units (5 MU) penicillin G potassium
benzylpenicillin.dose_conversion_note: 1 MU penicillin G potassium ≈ 600 mg (USP conversion 1595 units/mg for potassium salt, but clinical rule-of-thumb 1 MU = 600 mg is standard for penicillin G potassium per Drugs.com/AHFS). 5 MU × 600 mg/MU = 3000 mg. Alternative exact conversion (1595 U/mg) gives 5e6 / 1595 ≈ 3134 mg; 3000 mg chosen as the rounded clinical equivalent used in prescribing literature.

benzylpenicillin.notes: OATP1B1 substrate evidence from Hirano M et al 2006 Drug Metab Dispos 34:1229–1236 (penicillin G is a weak OATP1B1 substrate, in contrast to its stronger OAT3/MRP2 substrate roles). Renal clearance dominates disposition (~80% unchanged in urine via tubular secretion). Cmax reported here is the arithmetic mean from a 10-patient study, documented without SD in the FDA label narrative — consistent with rifampin entry precedent (label source, mean only). Bolus duration 3–5 min → 4 min midpoint used; route classified `iv_bolus` because the FDA label uses 'bolus' language. Measurement at 5–6 min post-end-of-bolus is effectively Cmax (slight distribution-phase attenuation may mean true Cmax is higher, but per spec A1 we report the observed clinical Cmax).

torsemide.notes: OATP1B1 substrate evidence from Werner U et al 2008 Pharmacogenet Genomics 18:357-366 and Vormfelde SV et al 2008 J Pharmacol Exp Ther (SLCO1B1 521T>C reduces torsemide clearance in humans, confirming hepatic OATP1B1 uptake contributes to disposition). Arithmetic mean +/- SD reported by Khan 2008 for the reference (marketed Cipla Dytor) formulation; test formulation (Macleods) gave 3399 +/- 582 ng/mL -- bioequivalent. Demadex FDA label (accessdata.fda.gov/label/2017/020136s027lbl.pdf) confirms qualitative PK (Cmax within 1 h, F approx 80%, half-life ~3.5 h) but does not tabulate a numeric Cmax at the 20 mg dose, hence use of the Khan 2008 primary paper. Caveat: single-study N=12 healthy males from an Indian bioequivalence trial -- smaller/more-homogeneous than ideal; CV of 13.5% is consistent with a tightly selected bioequivalence cohort. An alternative higher-quality source (Brater 1987 Clin Pharmacol Ther) exists but is paywalled and not verifiable through open channels in this session.

nerandomilast.notes: FDA NME approved January 2025 (Jascayd) for IPF and PPF. PDE4B preferential inhibitor. n=6 is at the minimum threshold; the phase I trial total enrolled 42 subjects (randomised 36 mg, 48 mg SAD + 6 mg, 12 mg MAD); each SAD cohort had n=6 healthy males. Geometric mean Cmax 710 nmol/L with gCV 20.7% at 36 mg (the lower of two single-dose cohorts; 48 mg gave 955 nmol/L, gCV 15.5%). Chose 36 mg as it is closer to the approved therapeutic dose range. OATP1B1 substrate status not explicitly stated in the PMC paper; classified false based on absence from known OATP1B1 substrate tables and PDE inhibitor class characteristics. Exclusion check: grep -iwx 'nerandomilast' /tmp/n50_exclusion.txt returned no match.

balcinrenone.notes: AstraZeneca MR modulator (AZD9977), Phase IIb for CKD with HF. Not FDA approved; included as non-NME drug with 2025 primary PK publication (PMC12199126 published 2025). Matched healthy controls are subjects with no clinically significant renal or hepatic disease. Paper reports P-glycoprotein and OAT3 contribute to active renal elimination; no OATP1B1 involvement described. The renal impairment study explicitly recruited a matched control cohort (eGFR >= 90) as the reference pharmacokinetic group -- these are the healthy subjects used here. Geometric mean conversion: 4602 nmol/L x 399.4 g/mol / 1000 = 1.838 mg/L. Exclusion check: grep -iwx 'balcinrenone' /tmp/n50_exclusion.txt returned no match.

tolebrutinib.notes: Sanofi BTK inhibitor for MS. Received FDA CRL December 2025 (not approved); included as non-NME drug with 2024 primary HV PK publication meeting 2024/2025+ criterion per spec. CV 64.7% is high but within acceptable range for CNS-penetrant covalent BTK inhibitor (rapid and extensive metabolism, short t1/2 ~2-5 h, active metabolite M2 has different PK). OATP1B1 substrate status not mentioned in the PMC paper or the mass balance study (PMC10480245); classified false based on absence from known OATP1B1 substrate lists and CYP3A4-dominant metabolism profile. Fasted condition chosen (lower food effect variability for reporting). Exclusion check: grep -iwx 'tolebrutinib' /tmp/n50_exclusion.txt returned no match.

zibotentan.notes: AstraZeneca endothelin A receptor antagonist (ZD4054). Originally developed for prostate cancer (Phase III failure 2012); revived by AZ for CKD and diabetic nephropathy (Phase II ongoing 2024-2026). Included as non-NME drug with 2024 primary HV PK publication. Healthy matched controls in the renal/hepatic impairment study constitute the healthy volunteer reference group (standard PK study design). No OATP1B1 substrate data found in any published source; classified false. Predominantly renally eliminated (~58% unchanged in urine); CYP3A4 is the major metabolic pathway per earlier xenobiotic studies (Xenobiotica 2011). Geometric mean Cmax 261.3 ng/mL = 0.261 mg/L at 5 mg oral dose. The earlier hepatic/renal impairment study (PMC3070638) also provides healthy control Cmax of ~550 ng/mL at 10 mg -- consistent with dose-proportional PK. Used 2024 paper as the primary source as it is more recent. Exclusion check: grep -iwx 'zibotentan' /tmp/n50_exclusion.txt returned no match.
